blocks.text: Yeh chapter 25 (Ecology) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb aur kitab ke number ke saath (MCQs 35-44, short 1-12, long 31-37, inquisitive 18-22, jaise chhape hain), hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; baqi sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
35. If you study the interaction between a herd of Markhors, the grass they eat, and the snow leopards that hunt them, which level of ecological organization are you focusing on?
(Agar aap Markhors ke rewar, un ki khayi jane wali ghaas aur un ka shikar karne wale snow leopards ke aapas ke taluq ka mutala karein, to yeh ecological organization ka kaun sa level hai?)
blocks.explanation: Community ek ilaqe mein rehne aur aapas mein taluq rakhne wali mukhtalif species ki tamam populations ka majmooa hai. Markhor, ghaas aur snow leopard mukhtalif species hain jo aapas mein taluq rakhti hain (25.1).

blocks.prompt:
36. Nitrogen-fixers are present in the group/s;
(Nitrogen fix karne wale jaandar kis group/groups mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter mein naam diye gaye tamam nitrogen fixers bacteria hain: azad rehne wale cyanobacteria (blue-green algae), Azotobacter aur Clostridium, aur dalon (legumes) ki jarr ki ganthon mein Rhizobium (25.2.2). Fungi decomposers hain.

blocks.prompt:
37. In an ecosystem, the energy flow is;
(Ecosystem mein energy ka bahao kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maadde ki cycling ke bar-aks energy ka bahao ek taraf hai: suraj se producers, phir consumers, aur har level par energy heat ban kar zaya hoti hai (25.3).

blocks.prompt:
38. Absorption and re-emission of heat radiation by the atmosphere is called;
(Atmosphere ka heat radiation ko jazb kar ke dobara kharij karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Greenhouse effect woh qudrati amal hai jis mein atmosphere ki gases zameen se nikalne wali heat ko rok leti hain aur zameen garm rehti hai (25.5). Global warming is ka barha hua, ghair qudrati nateeja hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Options ke label (a), (c), (c), (d) chhape hain: "Ozone depletion" par (c) chhapa hai, jabke (b) hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
39. A population's carrying capacity.
(Population ki carrying capacity:)

options.text: Bilkul durust hisab ki ja sakti hai
Aam tor par waqt ke saath ek jaisi rehti hai
Mahol ke halaat badalne se badal sakti hai
Kabhi paar nahi ki ja sakti

blocks.explanation: Carrying capacity limiting factors (khurak, paani, panah, ghonslon ki jagah, shikari, bimariyan) se tay hoti hai, is liye in ke badalne se badalti hai; maslan technology se insaan ne apne makan ki carrying capacity barha li (25.4, 25.4.1).

blocks.prompt:
40. During energy flow in ecosystems, how much of the energy at a trophic level enters the next level?
(Ecosystem mein energy ke bahao ke dauran ek trophic level ki kitni energy agle level mein jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf taqreeban 10% energy agle trophic level mein jati hai, maslan producers mein 10,000 kcal → primary consumers 1,000 kcal → 100 kcal → 10 kcal (25.3.2).

blocks.prompt:
41. Which group of bacteria is involved in nitrification?
(Nitrification mein bacteria ka kaun sa group shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrification Nitrosomonas (ammonia → nitrite) aur Nitrobacter (nitrite → nitrate) karte hain. Azotobacter, Clostridium aur Rhizobium nitrogen fix karte hain (25.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
42. Which step of nitrogen cycle is accomplished by Pseudomonas?
(Nitrogen cycle ka kaun sa qadam Pseudomonas anjam deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani se bhari mitti mein denitrifying bacteria jaise Pseudomonas aur Thiobacillus nitrates ko wapas nitrogen gas mein badalte hain (25.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
43. How do nitrogen-fixing bacteria contribute to the nitrogen cycle?
(Nitrogen fix karne wale bacteria nitrogen cycle mein kya hissa dalte hain?)

options.text: Nitrogen (N₂) atmosphere mein wapas bhejte hain
Ammonium ko nitrate mein badalte hain
N₂ ko ammonium mein badalte hain
Mitti se nitrate jazb karte hain

blocks.explanation: Nitrogen fix karne wale jaraseem mitti ki hawa se N₂ le kar ammonia (mitti mein ammonium) banate hain. (a) denitrification, (b) nitrification aur (d) assimilation hai (25.2.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Options "(a) … `(b) … (c) … (b) …" chhape hain: option (b) se pehle faltu backtick (`) hai, aur chautha option "Absorb nitrate from the soil" par (b) chhapa hai, jabke (d) hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
44. According to 2025-2026 climate data, the "Enhanced Greenhouse Effect" is considered as climate injustice for Pakistan because;
(2025-2026 ke climate data ke mutabiq "Enhanced Greenhouse Effect" Pakistan ke liye climate na-insafi kyun samjha jata hai?)

options.text: Pakistan duniya ki zyada tar greenhouse gases paida karta hai.
Greenhouse effect sirf South Asia mein hota hai.
Pakistan duniya ki GHGs ka 1% se kam kharij karta hai magar shadeed garmi aur selab jhelta hai.
Sanati mulkon ne carbon ka ikhraj bilkul rok diya hai.

blocks.explanation: Pakistan duniya ke GHG ikhraj ka 1% se kam hissa dalta hai magar climate change ke liye sab se kamzor 10 mulkon mein hai: heatwaves (Jacobabad, Sibi), glacial lake outburst floods aur 2025 ke selab (25.5).

blocks.prompt:
1. What are the primary reservoirs of the chemicals of biogeochemical cycles?
Biogeochemical cycles ke chemicals ke bunyadi zakheere (primary reservoirs) kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation:
Primary reservoir (sink ya pool) biosphere ka bara hissa hai jahan koi element lambe arse tak jama rehta hai.
1. Hawa ya samandar: gaseous cycles ke liye (nitrogen, oxygen, carbon aur water cycles).
2. Zameen ki parat (Earth's crust): sedimentary cycles ke liye (phosphorus, sulfur, calcium).

blocks.prompt:
2. Write notes on de-nitrification and ammonification.
Denitrification aur ammonification par notes likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Denitrification (atmosphere mein wapsi): paani se bhari mitti mein denitrifying bacteria (Pseudomonas, Thiobacillus) nitrates ko wapas nitrogen gas (N₂) banate hain jo hawa mein chali jati hai aur cycle mutawazin rehta hai.
Ammonification (dobara istemal ka qadam): paude aur janwar marein ya nitrogen wala fuzla kharij karein to decomposers (bacteria aur fungi) proteins tor kar organic nitrogen ko wapas ammonia banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Briefly describe the role of bacteria in the nitrogen cycle. Enlist their names and roles.
Nitrogen cycle mein bacteria ka kirdar mukhtasar bayan karein. Un ke naam aur kaam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Nitrogen fixation (N₂ → ammonia): azad cyanobacteria, Azotobacter, Clostridium; dalon ki jarr ki ganthon mein Rhizobium.
2. Nitrification: Nitrosomonas (ammonia → nitrite), Nitrobacter (nitrite → nitrate).
3. Ammonification: decomposer bacteria (fungi ke saath) organic nitrogen ko ammonia banate hain.
4. Denitrification: Pseudomonas, Thiobacillus (nitrate → N₂).

blocks.prompt:
4. Write a brief note on the flow of energy in trophic levels.
Trophic levels mein energy ke bahao par mukhtasar note likhein.
blocks.explanation: Energy ek taraf behti hai: suraj → producers → herbivores → carnivores. Producers dhoop ka sirf taqreeban 1-2% organic maadde mein badalte hain, aur har agle level mein sirf taqreeban 10% energy jati hai; baqi heat ban kar zaya (10,000 → 1,000 → 100 → 10 kcal). Is liye food chains mein sirf teen chaar levels, aur chhoti chains zyada efficient hain.

blocks.prompt:
5. Write brief notes on population density and population growth.
Population density aur population growth par mukhtasar notes likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Population density: fi unit raqba ya hajm afraad ki tadaad, maslan fi km² shahtoot ke darakht ya fi ml E. coli; carrying capacity ke qareeb zyada density se sakht muqabla, kam paidaish, zyada amwaat aur aaloodgi.
Population growth: muqarrara waqt mein afraad ki tadaad ka barhna. Exponential model: baghair hadd zyada se zyada raftar se (J shakal). Logistic model: growth sust ho kar carrying capacity par ruk jati hai (S shakal, sigmoid curve).

blocks.prompt:
6. Investigate the effects of human population growth on the environment.
Insani abadi ke barhne ke mahol par asraat ki tehqeeq karein.
blocks.explanation: Insani abadi ka tezi se barhna (2022 mein 8 arab; Pakistan 2023 mein 24 crore 14 lakh 90 hazar, 2.55% salana izafa) yeh asraat lata hai: qudrati makanon ki tabahi aur zameen ke istemal mein tabdeeli; meetha paani aur fossil fuels khatam hona; zyada fuzla aur aaloodgi; climate change; jangalon ki katai aur biodiversity ka nuqsan; ghurbat, mehngai, bhook aur wabaon ka zyada khatra.

blocks.prompt:
7. How does the increased greenhouses gases in atmosphere result in global warming?
Atmosphere mein greenhouse gases barhne se global warming kaise hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Greenhouse gases (CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, fluorinated gases) dhoop ko andar aane deti hain magar zameen se nikalne wali heat rok leti hain. Fossil fuels jalane aur jangal katne se CO₂ sanati daur se pehle taqreeban 280 ppm se 428 ppm (2026) ho gayi. Zyada GHGs zyada heat rokti hain (enhanced greenhouse effect), is liye zameen ka average darja-e-hararat barhta hai (1850-1900 se taqreeban 1.1 °C): global warming.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: "greenhouses gases" ki jagah "greenhouse gases" hona chahiye: "How do the increased greenhouse gases in the atmosphere result in global warming?"

blocks.prompt:
8. What are the long-term effects of global warming?
Global warming ke dair-pa (long-term) asraat kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Heatwaves (Jacobabad aur Sibi mein 50 °C se zyada), khushk sali aur jangal ki aag; be-tarteeb monsoon aur selab; glaciers ka pighalna, glacial lake outburst floods aur aakhir mein Indus ka sookh jana; samandar ki satah ka barhna aur sahil ka kataao (Thatta, Badin); khurak ki kami aur zameen ka sehra banna; ecosystems ki kharabi, species ki naql-e-makani aur khatma; keeron aur paani se phailne wali bimariyon ka phailao.

blocks.prompt:
9. Describe the unique adaptations of flora in the Mangrove ecosystem.
Mangrove ecosystem ke paudon ki khaas adaptations bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Mangrove ke darakht, zyada tar Avicennia marina (Timmar, jangal ka 95%), namak bardasht karte hain aur zameen-samandar ke milap par khare (brackish) paani mein ugte hain. In ki keechar anaerobic (oxygen ke baghair) hai, is liye in ki "saans lene wali jarrein" (pneumatophores) keechar se bahar nikal kar hawa leti hain. Yeh patton ke glands se faltu namak bhi kharij karte hain aur phaili jarron se narm keechar mein jame rehte hain (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
31. What is a biogeochemical cycle? Describe water cycle in detail.
Biogeochemical cycle kya hai? Water cycle tafseel se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Biogeochemical cycles kimiyai anasir, jaise carbon, nitrogen, oxygen aur phosphorus, ki ecosystem ke zinda (biotic) aur be-jaan (abiotic) hisson ke darmiyan chakkar wali harkat hain. Primary reservoir ke hisaab se: gaseous (hawa ya samandar: nitrogen, oxygen, carbon, water cycles) ya sedimentary (zameen ki parat: phosphorus, sulfur, calcium).
Water cycle (hydrological cycle): paani ki abiotic (hawa, mitti, samandar) aur biotic hisson ke darmiyan musalsal harkat. Pakistan ki zara'at Indus par munhasir hai, is liye yeh mulk ki shah-rag hai.
A. Abiotic loop:
1. Evaporation (bukharat): suraj cycle chalata hai; dhoop samandar aur jheelon ka paani garm karti hai aur paani bhaap banta hai. Duniya ki taqreeban 86% bukharat samandar se; Pakistan ke liye Arabian Sea bara zariya.
2. Condensation: oopar jati bhaap thandi ho kar qatre ya barf ke zarre banti hai jo gard se chimat kar badal banate hain.
3. Precipitation: bhaari qatre gravity se barish, barf ya ole mili barish (sleet) ban kar girte hain.
4. Infiltration: paani mitti mein jazb ho kar (percolation) water table tak jata hai aur zer-e-zameen paani (groundwater) ban kar jama hota hai.
5. Surface runoff: mitti mazeed jazb na kar sake to paani zameen par behta hai, naalon, daryaon (Indus) aur aakhir samandar mein.
B. Biotic loop:
1. Dakhla: paude root hairs se mitti ka paani le kar photosynthesis aur sahare (turgor) mein lagate hain; janwar paani peete aur khurak se lete hain.
2. Ikhraj: patton ke stomata se transpiration (sab se bara rasta); respiration se bana metabolic paani saans mein bhaap; excretion aur egestion (peshab, fuzla); paseena (bhaap ban kar urta hai); murda jismon ka decomposition paani mitti aur hawa mein lautata hai.

blocks.prompt:
32. Describe nitrogen cycle in detail.
Nitrogen cycle tafseel se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nitrogen cycle mein nitrogen biotic aur abiotic hisson mein ghoomti hai: hawa ki N₂ jaandaron ke qabil-e-istemal compounds banti hai aur phir wapas hawa mein jati hai. Hawa 78% N₂ hai, magar is ke atoms mazboot triple bond se jure hain jo paude nahi tor sakte. Paanch qadam:
1. Nitrogen fixation (mitti mein dakhla): N₂ ammonia (NH₃) ya doosre compounds banti hai, teen tareeqon se:
a. Biological fixation (90% se zyada): azad cyanobacteria (blue-green algae), Azotobacter aur Clostridium, aur chane aur moong jaisi dalon ki jarr ki ganthon mein Rhizobium.
b. Atmospheric fixation (5-10%): bijli ki energy N₂ ko oxygen se mila kar nitrogen oxides aur phir nitrates banati hai.
c. Industrial fixation: khaad ke liye N₂ aur hydrogen mila kar ammonia.
2. Nitrification (paudon ki khurak banana): Nitrosomonas ammonia ko nitrite (NO₂⁻), Nitrobacter nitrite ko nitrate (NO₃⁻) banata hai, jo paude aasani se lete hain.
3. Assimilation (zinda duniya mein dakhla): paude aur jaraseem nitrates le kar proteins, DNA aur chlorophyll banate hain; janwar paude aur doosre janwar kha kar nitrogen lete hain.
4. Ammonification (dobara istemal): jaandar marein ya nitrogen wala fuzla nikalein to decomposers (bacteria aur fungi) proteins tor kar organic nitrogen ko ammonia banate hain.
5. Denitrification (hawa mein wapsi): paani se bhari mitti mein Pseudomonas aur Thiobacillus nitrates ko N₂ gas banate hain jo hawa mein ja kar cycle mutawazin rakhti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sequence yaad karein: hawa N₂ → (fixation) ammonia → (nitrification) nitrite → nitrate → (assimilation) paude/janwar → (ammonification) ammonia → ... aur nitrate → (denitrification) N₂ hawa mein.

blocks.prompt:
33. Explain the flow of energy in successive trophic levels.
Pe dar pe trophic levels mein energy ka bahao bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Maadda chakkar lagata hai magar energy ecosystem mein ek hi simt mein behti hai.
Trophic levels (khurak ke groups):
1. Level 1: producers (hare paude, algae, photosynthetic bacteria).
2. Level 2: primary consumers ya herbivores (keere, khargosh).
3. Level 3: secondary consumers ya carnivores aur janwaron ke parasites (mendak, saanp).
4. Level 4: tertiary consumers jo carnivores khate hain (bheriya, baaz).
Decomposers aur detritivores (kekre, giddh, geedar) alag level hain jo tamam levels ke murda maadde (detritus) khate hain.
Energy ka bahao aur nuqsan:
1. Producers par girne wali dhoop ka sirf taqreeban 1-2% organic maadde ki bond energy banta hai.
2. Har level ki sirf taqreeban 10% energy agle level mein jati hai; baqi jaandar apne zindagi ke kaamon (respiration, harkat) mein lagate hain aur heat ban kar zaya, ya na hazam/murda maadde mein reh kar decomposers ko jati hai.
3. Misaal: producers 10,000 kcal → primary consumers 1,000 kcal → secondary 100 kcal → tertiary 10 kcal.
Nataij: oopar bohat kam energy bachti hai, is liye aam tor par sirf teen chaar trophic levels; chhoti food chains lambi chains se zyada efficient; energy dobara istemal nahi hoti, is liye ecosystem ko musalsal dhoop chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
34. Explain the problems related to the rapid growth of human populations and the effects of that growth on ecosystem.
Insani abadi ke tez barhne se mutaliq masail aur is ke ecosystem par asraat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tez izafe ki wajah: 1700 ke shuru se technology ne insaan ko khurak par zyada ikhtiyar, shikariyon ke khilaf hathiyar, bohat si bimariyon ka ilaj aur mausam se kam khatra diya, is liye insaan ne apne makan ki carrying capacity barha li.
Mojooda soorat: duniya 2022 mein 8 arab (7 se 8 arab 12 saal mein) aur 2050 tak taqreeban 10 arab. Taqreeban 16% (1.28 arab) taraqqi yafta aur 84% (6.72 arab) taraqqi pazeer mulkon mein. Pakistan ki 2023 ki census: 24 crore 14 lakh 90 hazar, 2.55% salana izafa; UN ke mutabiq 25 crore se zyada aur abadi mein duniya ka 5th mulk.
Masail aur ecosystem par asraat (biosphere ke liye sab se bara chaillenge):
1. Qudrati makanon ki tabahi aur zameen ke istemal mein tabdeeli (shehar, khet, sarkein).
2. Qudrati wasail ka khatma: meetha paani, fossil fuels.
3. Ghurbat aur mehngai.
4. Zyada fuzla aur hawa, paani, mitti ki aaloodgi.
5. Fossil fuels ke zyada istemal se climate change.
6. Jangalon ki katai aur biodiversity ka nuqsan.
7. Nayi wabaon, bhook aur ghiza ki kami ka zyada khatra.
8. Na-barabar istemal: sab se ameer 20% wasail ka 86% istemal aur CO₂ ka 53% paida karte hain, sab se ghareeb 20% sirf 1.3% aur 3%.
Insaan zameen ke biomass ka sirf taqreeban 0.01% hai, magar us ki tadaad aur istemal global mahol par shadeed dabao dalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
35. Describe the causes and impacts of the increasing concentration of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.
Atmosphere mein greenhouse gases ki barhti miqdar ki wajuhaat aur asraat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Greenhouse effect: atmosphere ki gases dhoop andar aane deti hain magar zameen ki heat rok leti hain, jis se zameen zindagi ke liye garm rehti hai. Zyada GHGs is asar ko barha deti hain.
Wajuhaat (bari GHGs ke zaraye):
1. Carbon dioxide (sab se aham; taqreeban 80% bataya gaya): machinery, gaariyon, garmaish aur bijli ke liye fossil fuels (koyla, tel, gas) jalana; jangalon ki katai.
2. Methane (taqreeban 11%): koyle aur gas ki paidawar, maweshi (gaye ke maide mein fermentation), zara'at.
3. Nitrous oxide (taqreeban 6%): zara'ati aur sanati kaam, fossil fuels jalana.
4. Fluorinated gases (taqreeban 3%): sanat, purane fridge aur AC se synthetic gases.
CO₂ sanati daur se pehle taqreeban 280 ppm se 2026 mein 428 ppm.
Asraat:
1. Global warming: 1850-1900 se average darja-e-hararat taqreeban 1.1 °C barha (IPCC 2023).
2. Heatwaves: Jacobabad aur Sibi mein 50 °C se zyada; heatstroke, maweshiyon par garmi ka dabao, keeron aur machharon ke liye garm sardiyan, khushk sali aur jangal ki aag.
3. Selab: garm hawa zyada nami rakhti hai, be-tarteeb shadeed monsoon (June 2025 selab: 1,000 se zyada amwaat, 30 lakh be-ghar); mitti ka kataao aur paani se bimariyan.
4. Glaciers ka pighalna: Baltoro aur Batura; glacial lake outburst floods (2025, Gilgit-Baltistan aur Chitral); aakhir mein Indus sookh sakta hai.
5. Samandar ki satah barhna aur sahil ka kataao: Thatta aur Badin mein samandari paani zameen kharab kar raha hai.
6. Khurak ki kami: phool aane ke waqt garmi gandum aur chawal ki paidawar ghatati hai; zameen sehra banti hai.
7. Ecosystem ki kharabi: species jagah badalti, hijrat karti ya khatam hoti hain.
Pakistan duniya ki GHGs ka 1% se kam kharij karta hai magar sab se kamzor 10 mulkon mein hai (climate na-insafi).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Topic lesson ki Kitab ki ghalti ke mutabiq yeh 80/11/6/3% asal mein ikhraj (emissions) ka hissa hain (USA ke data), warming mein hissa nahi; warming mein CO₂ taqreeban 66% hai. Imtihan mein kitab wale number likhein magar yeh farq yaad rakhein.

blocks.prompt:
36. Provide a comprehensive account of the Tropical Thorn Forest of Pakistan. Give its location, key flora and fauna, and its current ecological state.
Pakistan ke tropical thorn forest ka mukammal bayan dein: jagah, aham paude aur janwar, aur mojooda ecological halat.
blocks.explanation:
Taaruf: Pakistan ke maidani ilaqon ka sab se phaila hua zameeni ecosystem, jis mein xerophytic (khushk sali bardasht karne wale) kaante dar paude hain; kaante herbivores ko door rakhte aur paani ka nuqsan kam karte hain.
Jagah: Indus plains: Punjab ka bara hissa (Bahawalpur, Khanewal, Mianwali, Dera Ghazi Khan), Sindh (Indus ke saath junoobi ilaqe) aur Balochistan (maghribi ilaqe).
Abiotic profile: khushk se neem khushk mausam; garmi mein 50 °C tak; kam barish, salana 200 se 750 mm.
Aham paude: Prosopis cineraria (jhand/kandi), Salvadora oleoides (peelu/wan), Capparis aphylla (karir) aur Vachellia nilotica (kikar); kaante dar, chhote patton wale, khushk sali bardasht karne wale darakht aur jhariyan.
Aham janwar: oont, houbara bustard, chinkara, geedar, Balochistan gerbil, sehi aur saanp (kitab rattlesnakes likhti hai, magar woh sirf America mein hain; yahan ka aam zehreela saanp saw-scaled viper hai).
Mojooda halat: buri tarah tabah (heavily degraded). Zyada tar qudrati jangal insani abadiyon aur Punjab ki nehri zara'at ke liye kaat diye gaye, jis se makan aur janwar khatam hue.

blocks.prompt:
37. Write a detailed note on the Temperate Deciduous Forest in Pakistan.
Pakistan ke temperate deciduous forest par tafseeli note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Taaruf: nam pahari ilaqon ke jangal jahan wazeh mausam hain aur thandi sardi mein darakht patte gira dete hain (deciduous).
Jagah: shimali ilaqe: Shogran, Neelam Valley, Murree aur Kaghan ke kuch hisse.
Abiotic profile: zarkhez surmai-bhoori mitti jis mein organic maadda (humus) zyada; mo'tadil mausam, 4 °C se 30 °C; salana barish 750 se 1500 mm.
Aham paude: Taxus baccata (yew), Pinus wallichiana (blue pine/kail), Cedrus deodara (deodar) aur jhariyan jaise Berberis lyceum (sumbal).
Aham janwar: rhesus bandar (Macaca mulatta), kala reechh, leopard cat, bheriye aur mukhtalif parinde.
Mojooda halat: tabah haal (degraded). Bohat se bare shikari janwar khatam ho chuke, aur jangal lakri ki sanat aur kheti ke phailao ke dabao mein hai.
Ahmiyat: humus wali mitti aur mausami patjhar bharpoor communities ko sahara dete hain; in jangalon ka tahaffuz biodiversity aur paani bachata hai (chapter se aage: yeh dhalwanon ko kataao se bhi bachate hain).

blocks.prompt:
18. Justify the fact that humans are responsible for climate change.
Saabit karein ke climate change ke zimmedar insaan hain.
blocks.explanation:
1. Qudrati greenhouse effect zameen ko mustahkam rakhta tha; GHGs, khaas kar CO₂, ka wazeh izafa zyada tar insan ke machinery, gaariyon, garmaish aur bijli ke liye fossil fuels jalane se hai.
2. CO₂ sanati daur se pehle taqreeban 280 ppm se 2026 mein 428 ppm hui, bilkul sanat aur abadi ke barhne ke saath.
3. Doosri GHGs bhi insani: koyle/gas aur maweshiyon aur kheti se methane; kheti aur sanat se nitrous oxide; fluorinated gases to poori tarah lab mein bani hain.
4. Jangalon ki katai woh darakht khatam karti hai jo CO₂ jazb karte.
5. 1850-1900 se darja-e-hararat taqreeban 1.1 °C barha (IPCC 2023), yahi sanati daur hai.
6. Tez abadi istemal aur ikhraj barhati hai; sab se ameer 20% CO₂ ka 53% paida karte hain.
Is liye barhi hui ghair qudrati garmi insani sargarmiyon ka sab se bara manfi asar hai; sirf qudrati wajuhaat se yeh wazeh nahi hoti (chapter ise "enhanced, unnatural warming" kehta hai).

blocks.prompt:
19. Investigate the effects of human population growth on ecosystem.
Insani abadi ke barhne ke ecosystem par asraat ki tehqeeq karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tehqeeq ka tareeqa aur nataij:
1. Izafe ka saboot: duniya 8 arab (2022), 2050 tak taqreeban 10 arab; Pakistan 24 crore 14 lakh 90 hazar (2023 census), 2.55% salana; 84% log taraqqi pazeer mulkon mein.
2. Ecosystems par asraat:
a. Makanon ki tabahi aur zameen ke istemal mein tabdeeli: maslan tropical thorn forest ka zyada tar hissa abadiyon aur nehri kheti ke liye kat gaya.
b. Wasail ka khatma: meetha paani, fossil fuels; temperate deciduous forest par lakri ki sanat ka dabao.
c. Aaloodgi aur fuzla: maslan Karachi ki aaloodgi mangroves ke liye khatra.
d. Fossil fuel ke barhte istemal se climate change.
e. Jangalon ki katai aur biodiversity ka nuqsan; bare shikari khatam; chhoti populations (maslan Himalayan brown bear) minimal viable size se neeche, jis se inbreeding aur khatme ka khatra.
f. Samaji asraat: ghurbat, mehngai, bhook, ghiza ki kami aur wabaon ka zyada khatra.
3. Tareeqa (chapter se aage): saalon ka census data, jangalon ke naqshe aur janwaron ki ginti ka muqabla, aur qareebi ilaqe mein zameen ke istemal, fuzle aur paani ka survey.
Nateeja: tezi se barhti insani abadi shayad biosphere ke mustaqbil ka sab se bara chaillenge hai.

blocks.prompt:
20. Justify why science education has become necessary for everyone to understand the steps man has to take to save the biosphere.
Wazeh karein ke biosphere bachane ke liye insaan ke qadam samajhne ke liye science ki taleem har kisi ke liye kyun zaroori ho gayi hai.
blocks.explanation:
1. Khatre scientific hain: greenhouse effect, nitrogen aur water cycles, energy flow aur carrying capacity samajh kar hi pata chalta hai ke fossil fuels, jangalon ki katai, zyada abadi aur aaloodgi biosphere ko kyun nuqsan deti hain.
2. Har shakhs hissa daar: roz ke faisle (bijli, gaari, paani, fuzla, khandan ka size) jama ho kar bara asar banate hain; science samajhne wale apna asar kam kar sakte hain.
3. Pakistan sab se kamzor 10 mulkon mein: shehriyon ko heatwaves, selab, GLOFs aur samandar ki satah barhne ko samajh kar tayyari karni hai.
4. Policies ki samajhdar himayat: shajarkari, mangroves aur jangalon ka tahaffuz, saaf energy aur khandani mansooba bandi awaam ki samajh se hi kamyab hoti hain.
5. Ghalat maloomat se bachao: science (aur biostatistics) daawon aur data ko sahi parakhne mein madad deti hai.
6. Wasail ka paidaar (sustainable) istemal: energy dobara istemal nahi hoti aur wasail mehdood hain, yeh samajh bachat sikhati hai.
Is liye biosphere bachane ke samajhdar, ijtimai qadmon ke liye sab ke liye science ki taleem zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
21. Investigate the careers related to the study of environmental resources.
Mahol ke wasail ke mutale se mutaliq careers ki tehqeeq karein.
blocks.explanation:
Careers (chapter se aage; chapter ke mauzuaat se mutaliq misaalein):
1. Ecologist / wildlife biologist: populations, communities aur ecosystems ka mutala, maslan snow leopard, markhor, Indus dolphin.
2. Forest officer: temperate, thorn aur mangrove jangalon ka intezam; shajarkari aur hifazat.
3. Environmental scientist / pollution control officer (Environmental Protection Agency): hawa, paani, mitti ki aaloodgi aur fuzle ki nigrani.
4. Climate scientist / meteorologist: greenhouse gases, global warming, monsoon aur selab (Pakistan Meteorological Department).
5. Hydrologist / water resource engineer: water cycle, darya, zer-e-zameen paani aur glaciers.
6. Soil / agricultural scientist: nitrogen cycle, khaad, zameen ka sehra banna aur fasal ki paidawar.
7. Marine biologist: sahil aur mangroves.
8. Demographer / biostatistician: abadi ka izafa aur sehat ka data.
9. NGOs (maslan WWF-Pakistan) aur national parks mein conservation officer; mahol ke wakeel, sahafi ya ustaad.
Raasta: FSc pre-medical, phir environmental sciences, botany, zoology, forestry, agriculture ya geography mein BS, aur aage taleem ya training.

blocks.prompt:
22. Activity: Search internet and collect the pictures of the key fauna and flora of different ecosystems in Pakistan.
Activity: internet par talash kar ke Pakistan ke mukhtalif ecosystems ke aham janwaron aur paudon ki tasveerein jama karein.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh student ki apni project activity hai; chapter ke mutabiq kya jama karein:
1. Temperate deciduous forest (Shogran, Neelam, Murree, Kaghan): yew, blue pine, deodar, sumbal; rhesus bandar, kala reechh, leopard cat, bheriya.
2. Tropical thorn forest (Indus plains): jhand, peelu, karir, kikar; oont, houbara bustard, chinkara, geedar, Balochistan gerbil, sehi.
3. Alpine aur sub-alpine meadows (Gilgit-Baltistan, Chitral, Swat, AJK, Deosai): chhote juniper, birch (bhoj patra), willow, alpine ghaas aur jungli phool; snow leopard, Himalayan brown bear, ibex, musk deer, marmot, snowcock, monal, golden eagle.
4. Mangrove forest (Indus delta, Balochistan ka sahil): timmar (Avicennia marina) saans lene wali jarron ke saath; magarmachh, jheenga, mudskipper, kekra, lobster, kachhwa, dolphin, flamingo, saaras, pelican.
Pesh karne ka tareeqa: har ecosystem ka ek safha ya slide; har tasveer par aam aur scientific naam; har tasveer ka zariya likhein; qabil-e-aitbaar websites (maslan WWF-Pakistan, national parks) aur sirf taleemi istemal ki ijazat wali tasveerein.
